children: A whale accumulated several tokens over the past 24 hours, including PONS, CASHCAT, AAVE, and UNI. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the whale bought 3.23 million PONS with 913 ETH, 1.69 million CASHCAT with 160 ETH, 7,270 AAVE with 1 million USDC, and 156,450 UNI with 850,000 USDC.
The purchases were tracked by Onchain Lens on September 5.

title: Whale Buys PONS, CASHCAT, AAVE, and UNI in Recent On-Chain Activity
